label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves and eight lanterns. Innkeeper, freight and builder coordinated supplies, baking, delivery, lighting and an inspection cover appointment; baker knowingly supplied bread and kept the surprise private, and neighbour knowingly arranged to accompany the mayor without revealing it. The mayor was told about a lighting inspection and later bread delivery, but the shown record does not show anyone telling the mayor about the jubilee. No evidence establishes that the secretary knowingly helped conceal the celebration.
